notes.title: Devlog #7: New UI and Language Selection
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=UaTOZY4G27Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey guys!
It has been quite a while I don't post an update on my game, and that is because I've been working on not-so-interesting stuff lately. To prepare my demo for launch is not an easy task, but it is coming along nicely!
Today I came to show you some cool update I made to the game, such as a new UI for the car crash screen and a language selection screen. The beta will be available on English, Portuguese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese!
I hope you enjoy the video!!
